## CIE Chemistry (9701) Comprehensive Dashboard
Welcome to the unified Cambridge International A-Level Chemistry resource center. Here you can find syllabus materials, lesson-by-lesson notes, topical practice questions (QP & MS), structured past papers, and our interactive exam search engine.
:::

## 1. COURSE OVERVIEW & SYLLABUS

Cambridge International AS & A Level Chemistry (Syllabus Code: **9701**) provides a comprehensive foundation in physical, inorganic, and organic chemistry. The course is structured into two main stages: AS Level (typically taken in the first year) and A2 Level (taken in the second year).

### Assessment Outline (Papers 1 to 5)

The complete A-Level qualification consists of five examination papers. The table below summarizes the structure, duration, and weighting of each paper:

## 5. OFFICIAL PAST PAPERS BANK


```{=html}
<div class="card p-3 mb-4 shadow-sm" style="border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.08);">
  <div class="card-body p-0">
    <div class="d-flex align-items-center flex-wrap gap-4">
      
      <!-- Year Select Dropdown -->
      <div class="d-flex align-items-center gap-2" style="min-width: 200px;">
        <span style="font-size: 0.95rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--bs-body-color); white-space: nowrap;">Year:</span>
        <select id="filter-year" class="form-select form-select-sm" onchange="selectYearDropdown(this)" style="max-width: 140px; display: inline-block;">
          <option value="">All Years</option>
        </select>
      </div>
      
      <!-- Vertical Divider on desktop -->
      <div class="d-none d-md-block" style="border-left: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.1); height: 24px;"></div>
      
      <!-- Paper Pills -->
      <div class="d-flex align-items-center gap-2 flex-grow-1">
        <span style="font-size: 0.95rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--bs-body-color); white-space: nowrap;">Paper:</span>
        <div id="paper-pills" class="d-flex flex-wrap gap-1">
          <button class="btn btn-sm btn-primary smart-paper-btn active" data-paper="" onclick="selectPaper(this)">All</button>
          <button class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-secondary smart-paper-btn" data-paper="Paper 1" onclick="selectPaper(this)">Paper 1</button>
          <button class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-secondary smart-paper-btn" data-paper="Paper 2" onclick="selectPaper(this)">Paper 2</button>
          <button class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-secondary smart-paper-btn" data-paper="Paper 3" onclick="selectPaper(this)">Paper 3</button>
          <button class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-secondary smart-paper-btn" data-paper="Paper 4" onclick="selectPaper(this)">Paper 4</button>
          <button class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-secondary smart-paper-btn" data-paper="Paper 5" onclick="selectPaper(this)">Paper 5</button>
        </div>
      </div>

    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<script>
let currentSelectedYear = '';
let currentSelectedPaper = '';

function applySmartFilters() {
  const list = window['quarto-listings'] ? window['quarto-listings']['listing-past-papers-list'] : null;
  if (!list) return;

  list.filter(function(item) {
    const itemValues = item.values();
    
    // Read values
    const itemYear = itemValues['listing-year'] ? itemValues['listing-year'].trim() : '';
    const itemPaper = itemValues['listing-paper'] ? itemValues['listing-paper'].trim() : '';
    
    // Match filters
    const matchYear = !currentSelectedYear || itemYear === currentSelectedYear;
    const matchPaper = !currentSelectedPaper || itemPaper === currentSelectedPaper;

    return matchYear && matchPaper;
  });
}

function selectYearDropdown(select) {
  currentSelectedYear = select.value || '';
  applySmartFilters();
}

function selectPaper(button) {
  currentSelectedPaper = button.getAttribute('data-paper') || '';
  
  // Update button active state
  const buttons = document.querySelectorAll('.smart-paper-btn');
  buttons.forEach(btn => {
    btn.classList.remove('btn-primary', 'active');
    btn.classList.add('btn-outline-secondary');
  });
  button.classList.remove('btn-outline-secondary');
  button.classList.add('btn-primary', 'active');
  
  applySmartFilters();
}

function populateYearDropdown() {
  const list = window['quarto-listings'] ? window['quarto-listings']['listing-past-papers-list'] : null;
  if (!list) return;

  const yearSelect = document.getElementById('filter-year');
  if (!yearSelect) return;

  const years = new Set();
  list.items.forEach(function(item) {
    const year = item.values()['listing-year'];
    if (year) years.add(year.trim());
  });

  const sortedYears = Array.from(years).sort((a, b) => parseInt(b) - parseInt(a));

  // Clear and add "All Years" option
  yearSelect.innerHTML = '<option value="">All Years</option>';
  
  sortedYears.forEach(function(year) {
    const option = document.createElement('option');
    option.value = year;
    option.textContent = year;
    yearSelect.appendChild(option);
  });
}

// Hook into Quarto listing initialization to populate dropdown and bind events
(function() {
  function initSmartFilters() {
    const list = window['quarto-listings'] ? window['quarto-listings']['listing-past-papers-list'] : null;
    if (list && list.items && list.items.length > 0) {
      populateYearDropdown();
    } else {
      setTimeout(initSmartFilters, 100);
    }
  }
  
  // Start polling for list initialization
  if (document.readyState === "loading") {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", initSmartFilters);
  } else {
    initSmartFilters();
  }
})();
</script>
```
